description: This file defines API route handlers for an authentication system using FastAPI and Supabase. It includes endpoints for user sign-up, email verification, sign-in, password recovery, and password reset, along with utilization of external services such as email sending, verification code management, and Supabase client interactions.

methods.name: SignUpResponse signup( payload: SignUpRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Creates a new user in Supabase, generates a verification code, and sends it via email.

methods.name: None send_verification_code( payload: SendVerificationCodeRequest, request: Request, email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Resends a verification code to the user's email address.

methods.name: None verify_code( payload: VerifyCodeRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Verifies the email using a sent code and marks the email as verified in the profile.

methods.name: AuthTokenResponse signin( payload: SignInRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Authenticates a user via email and password, returning an access token.

methods.name: None forgot_password( payload: ForgotPasswordRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Initiates password recovery by sending a reset link to email.

methods.name: None reset_password( payload: ResetPasswordRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Performs password reset using an admin-provided approach, given the context.
